Registering the contract with `collapsed-state-guard` is how it stops regressing. A cheap complement, not a substitute: give `config/instruments.yaml` a maxOrderQty so the offline profile can answer at all - today it structurally cannot, which is why (c) is the common case and not the rare one. Done-condition: a forced lookup failure produces a refusal with a typed reason, and NOT an exchange_rejected row.
